messages:
elaine: seeing sustained p99 spikes on apac-edge-3 GPU hosts (edge-gpu-12..14). egress queue looks saturated.
raj: can you paste traceroute + any exabgp dumps?
elaine: traceroute to 10.22.9.8 (10.22.9.8), 8 hops max
 1 10.22.0.1 0.38 ms
 2 10.22.1.6 1.02 ms
 3 198.51.100.12 13.4 ms
 4 203.0.113.5 48.0 ms
 5 10.22.9.8 48.2 ms

marta: infra-bot: "apac-edge-3 egress_queue_depth=72% for 10m, nodes edge-gpu-12..14 impacted"
raj: we pushed an AS-path prepend yesterday to steer cheap transit. extra hop + bursty tenant can blow queues.
elaine: rollback BGP is an option but costly. alternative: steer noisy tenant t-9c1a to apac-dedicated-pool-3 for 12-24h and throttle at proxy.
tom: steer cost ~= +10 GPU-hours prefill, ~0.5% pool usage for 24h. rollback transit delta est +$130/day. steer cheaper short-term.
marta: applied steer via API (change_id c-1745).
infra-bot: routing change applied for t-9c1a -> apac-dedicated-pool-3, change_id c-1745; egress_queue_depth before=72% after=39% (1m)
elaine: p99 on affected hosts dropped 820ms -> 200ms in first 10m window.
raj: enabled proxy throttle: `proxy.throttle.set('t-9c1a', rps=180, burst=40)` and kvcache LRU trim on that pool.
marta: added auto-unsteer at 2025-07-05T04:00Z unless extended; alert if egress_queue_depth>60% or p99>400ms -> page #oncall.
tom: file INFRA-1182 to assess AS-path steering risk across apac-edge, assign raj.
elaine: monitoring on, will update if anything regresses. thanks all :v:
